title: Our two-person deckbuilder demo hit #2 in New & Trending for card games
author: PowerSpikeStudio
selftext:
We're a duo making Beyond Realm, a deckbuilding roguelite. Our free demo went out on Steam Saturday morning, and yesterday it reached #2 in New & Trending for card games.  
  
AI produced the card illustrations and the starting point of the town art. We retouched those by hand, and wrote the rules, balance, combat and town upgrades ourselves of course.  
  
Making the pictures was never the hard part. Getting a hundred plus cards to look like the same game was. What fixed it for us: same ink frame on every card, same style, a set backdrop per element, and anything that drifted got binned... but it is still not perfect and we are working on it to improve it.  
  
The demo holds the tutorial plus act 1, roughly an hour and twenty. Play it, decide for yourself whether it holds together, and please share your advice. That would really help us !

Thanks ! 

Here is the link so you can check and play: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5244390/Beyond\_Realm/?utm\_source=reddit&utm\_campaign=aigamedev-top2](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5244390/Beyond_Realm/?utm_source=reddit&utm_campaign=aigamedev-top2)

comments.author: Fit_Eye_3564
comments.body: Are you the creator of grimoria? Your cards look exactly the same.

replies.author: PowerSpikeStudio
replies.body: Haha, nope! But that's a great compliment, Grimoria has amazing visuals. I guess we're on the right track! :-)
